```yaml
name: Build Daytona Snapshot
on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: The name of the built Daytona snapshot
        value: ${{ jobs.build_snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}
jobs:
  build_snapshot:
    runs-on: ${{ github.repository_owner == 'iterate' && 'depot-ubuntu-24.04-arm-4' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.set_snapshot_name.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Validate commit SHA
        run: |
          if [[ ! "${{ github.sha }}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF is not a valid 40-character commit SHA"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Build Daytona snapshot
        id: build_snapshot
        env:
          DAYTONA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DAYTONA_API_KEY }}
          SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          pnpm os snapshot:daytona
          echo "snapshot_name=iterate-sandbox-${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Set snapshot name output
        id: set_snapshot_name
        run: |
          echo "snapshot_name=iterate-sandbox-${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
```
